author: erney007
quote: This game has nothing special about the gameplay but it’s hilarious to play. It’s like watching a Southpark movie that everything seems to come out of nowhere all the time. Butter is my best boy. Give it a 10 because this is what gaming is all about: to have fun!
game_title: South Park: The Stick of Truth

author: erney007
quote: This game makes me buy PS4. The scenery is remarkable. The gameplay has more features and more detail. I don’t like stealth but the lock on system helps a lot. Much larger map to explore. The story is as good as always, l Iove what they put in New Davon, the first cut scene in this city really got me in awe.

author: erney007
quote: What a storytelling! Open with Nate out of nowhere in danger that intrigues me to play more. The game play is fun. Great dialogue and voice acting. The scenery is top notch. Also have some mystery element. Nathan and Elena are great couple. Replaying it many times.

author: erney007
quote: The world is fantastic, the story needs sometime to explore but the game hook me with action right after the tutorial. It’s hard but challenging, I upgrade myself and come back for a rematch and when I defeated the enemies it feels rewarding. Minus point because the dogs and bears are too OP and it use many reskinned but overall it’s one of the most enjoyable play, encourage me to platinum the game.

author: erney007
quote: Rockstar really wasted its technology to bad writing, annoying and flat characters, and relationship points that too scared to fail they remove hookers and cheating system. GTA San Andrea with this latest technology would be a blast and deserves 99 score rather than this slop. Might get better score if the characters is are better than this.

author: erney007
quote: I’ve played it in 1999. I’ve played it in 3ds. Now I went into it again expecting some nostalgia but it gives me more than that. This game again succeeds to make me cares about their world and every npc living in it. I see how beautiful Hyrule is and how it is destroyed and I want to save it. When the credits role, the music and the scenes make me feel like ah… it feels so good saving this world. Nintendo has made another history and reminds us that this is gaming, it’s fun.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
